atAGlance: Hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho is a Mekong Delta rice-noodle soup from the Mỹ Tho style, known for clear broth, chewy noodles, pork, shrimp, herbs, and fried garlic.
whatItIs: Hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho is a Mekong Delta rice-noodle soup with clear broth, chewy noodles, pork, shrimp, fried garlic, and herbs. It is lighter than phở but still satisfying.
howToEnjoy: Ask whether the shop serves it nước or khô. For khô, mix the dry noodles with their savory dressing, then sip the clear pork-and-seafood broth from the side bowl between bites.
howLocalsOrder: Hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho is often worth ordering khô, dry style, if you want the toppings and fried garlic to stand out. Ask for soup on the side so you can alternate bites and broth.
worthKnowing: Mỹ Tho is a Mekong Delta city, and the name signals a southern rice-noodle style rather than a random topping.
goodToKnow: Mỹ Tho is a Mekong Delta name to recognize. The dry version should still come with broth, because that clear, sweet side bowl is the backbone of the noodles.
regionalAssociation: Mỹ Tho and the Mekong Delta
